name: Craft
tagline: Turn your notes into styled documents with linked pages, tasks, and shared spaces.
description:
Craft is a document and note workspace for turning ideas into structured pages that can also hold tasks, collections, and shared material. Its Mac app gives writers a visual editor, linked pages, and daily notes without requiring every idea to begin as a formal project.

Start with a document or daily note, build it from text and other blocks, link related pages, then share a polished page or collaborate in a Space. The same account can sync work across Mac, iPhone, iPad, and the web.

## Features

- Build styled documents with nested pages, cards, tables, media, and linked content.
- Capture tasks and reminders within notes, then review them from task and daily-note views.
- Share individual documents or collaborate with others in shared Spaces.
- Export work to portable formats including PDF and Markdown.

## Where it fits

Craft suits people who want attractive documents and lightweight planning in one place. Its block-based editor is more visual than a plain Markdown file, but that also means the primary workspace lives inside Craft rather than an ordinary folder of text files.

## Privacy and requirements

A Craft account and its sync service handle cross-device and collaborative content. Offline access is supported on Mac, but shared documents, attachments, and AI requests involve Craft or connected services. Review workspace permissions before putting confidential material in a shared Space.

## Pricing

Craft has a free plan with 1,500 blocks and 1 GB of storage. Plus removes the content limit and is listed at $8 monthly or $6.40 per month when billed yearly; other family and team plans are available.
pricingDetails: Free plan; Plus from $6.40/month billed yearly
